---
title: "Method"
---

## Core distinction

- **agent** — the entity to which action is attributed;
- **agency** — the capacity exercised;
- **mechanism** — the process producing an effect;
- **medium** — that through which agency becomes effective;
- **manifestation** — the observable result;
- **interpretation** — the meaning assigned to that result.

## Paired restraint principles

**Explanatory restraint:** assess more observable mechanisms before invoking a
less observable and more ontologically demanding agent.

**Non-reductive mediation:** identifying a psychological, social, or
institutional mechanism does not by itself prove spiritual mediation impossible.
